preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array n must be between 2 and 200000.
The constant m must be at least 1.
The number of subarrays k must be at least 2.
The product of m and k must not exceed n.
Each element in the array a must be within the range -1000000000 to 1000000000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the maximum possible sum of beauties followed by the partition indices.
The number of partition indices must be exactly k - 1.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= p[i] < p[i + 1] < n for i in range(k - 2))
postconditions.description: The partition indices must be strictly increasing and within the valid range.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"2 <= n <= 200000","description":"The number of elements in the array n must be between 2 and 200000."},{"id":"P2","expression":"1 <= m","description":"The constant m must be at least 1."},{"id":"P3","expression":"2 <= k","description":"The number of subarrays k must be at least 2."},{"id":"P4","expression":"m * k <= n","description":"The product of m and k must not exceed n."},{"id":"P5","expression":"all(-1000000000 <= a[i] <= 1000000000 for i in range(n))","description":"Each element in the array a must be within the range -1000000000 to 1000000000."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == str(max_beauty) + '\\n' + ' '.join(map(str, partition_indices))","description":"The output must contain the maximum possible sum of beauties followed by the partition indices."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"len(partition_indices) == k - 1","description":"The number of partition indices must be exactly k - 1."},{"id":"Q3","expression":"all(1 <= p[i] < p[i + 1] < n for i in range(k - 2))","description":"The partition indices must be strictly increasing and within the valid range."}],"invariants":[]}
